reading: Products and variants: Shopify's Products section, routes and API (SH-S-1509, SH-S-5015). M-011 holds Salla's products, options and variants, categories and brands (SA-C-020 to SA-C-023) as four concerns; Shopify's one concern is coarser, so it lands in the parent. Its variant statements are cited in CM-CAT-002, its tags and media in CM-CAT-006 and CM-CAT-007.

Salla's Products section, editor, settings and Merchant API folder (SA-S-1791, SA-S-1796, SA-S-1022). Its sub-parts that have their own capabilities are cited there: tags (CM-CAT-006), media (CM-CAT-007), pricing (CM-CAT-013) in this tree; and, outside CM-CAT-001's tree, its bundle flags in CM-SEL-006 (SA-S-3510, SA-S-3385, SA-S-3297, SA-S-3522) and its donation setting and flags in CM-SEL-007 (SA-S-1760, SA-S-2616, SA-S-2399, SA-S-3118, SA-S-3481), which is why the fit is strained (S1). Its filters, sorting and recommendations are storefront matters of other domains and are not cited (notes).
Product Options, Option Values, Variants and Option Templates (SA-S-1025, SA-S-1031, SA-S-1051). M-011 joins it with Shopify's products and variants (SH-C-020), which land in the parent CM-CAT-001.

Custom products and product options: the App Store's Custom product apps category (SH-S-2644). Joined by the term variant: the concern's platform term 'Product variant apps' is named in SH-S-7214, which says Shopify's plan creates up to 100 variants for each product and that product variant apps may add features for customization, pricing and inventory; Salla's Product Variants and Product Options (SA-S-1031, SA-S-1025) are the same object, the variants of a product. Rules U-059.

Categories (SA-S-1053, SA-S-1974). M-011 joins it with Shopify's products (SH-C-020, in the parent CM-CAT-001). Its taxonomy features (google-taxonomy, salla-taxonomy) are cited in the child CM-CAT-004.

A reading, joined on role: Shopify's collections and Salla's categories are both the store's own groupings of its products, under different names. Shopify: a product is added to or removed from a collection by hand, or by the collection's rules (SH-S-6097), and a staff permission adds products to a collection (SH-S-6278). Salla: a product's category (تصنيف المنتج) is updated (SA-S-1597), and its plan line names product categories (تصنيفات المنتجات, SA-S-1974). Neither side's statements define the other's term. Shopify's 'product categories' in its tax statements are another thing (notes, homonyms). Rules U-002.
Brands (SA-S-1056, SA-S-1757). M-011 joins it with Shopify's products (SH-C-020, in the parent CM-CAT-001); Shopify holds no brand concern or statement (CM-CAT-005's Shopify cell).
Combined listings: a plan row included on Plus only (SH-S-7071) and the GraphQL Admin API object CombinedListing, 'A combined listing of products.' (SH-S-7455). No Salla concern or statement.

Product restrictions (قيود المنتج): a dashboard link, a Pro plan line and the sales-restrictions feature (SA-S-1801, SA-S-2136, SA-S-3505). No Shopify concern joins it; Shopify's add-to-cart limit (SH-C-046, domain C) is kept apart (notes).

The App Store's Dropshipping and Finding products categories (SH-S-2568, SH-S-2566). No Salla concern of domain B joins it: Salla's Drop shipping apps (SA-C-124, domain C) and wholesale market (SA-C-098, domain D) are cited in the Salla cell. Rules U-016.
Subscription apps, subscription contracts and selling plans (SH-S-2657, SH-S-0762, SH-S-6286).
The Recurring Payments API and the subscription webhooks (SA-S-1173, SA-S-1642): subscriptions a store sells to its customers, as M-074 reads them.
Digitals Product and digital card history (SA-S-1029, SA-S-1894).

Digital goods and service apps (SH-S-2648), by M-076. What doesn't fit: the concern also holds the App Store's Event booking apps (SH-I-1887, an inventory entry with no statement), which is bookings and is cited in CM-SEL-004, outside CM-SEL-002's tree (C2, S1). Its NFT and token-gating part fits the child CM-SEL-003, where its Blockchain route and the NFT and tokengating apps category are cited (SH-S-5094, SH-I-1888). A reviewer may split the event part. Rules U-061.
Bookings and Order Reservations (SA-S-1779, SA-S-1023). Q1 matches it with WooCommerce's bookings (M-081), which WooCommerce's part lands; no Shopify concern joins it (U-061).
Pre-order campaigns (SA-S-1799, SA-S-3508). No Shopify concern joins it: Shopify's 'Pre-order apps' is a platform term of SH-C-188 with no statement (U-059).

Its statements are the App Store's Upsell and bundle apps category (SH-S-2604), the product_configuration extension template (SH-S-2207) and the Storefront API's bundles scope (SH-S-1100): bundles. What doesn't fit: upsell and cross-sell, which domain D's offers hold (U-057), and the App Store's Pre-order apps (SH-I-1842, an inventory entry with no statement), which is cited in CM-SEL-005, outside CM-SEL-006's tree (C2, S1). No Salla concern lands with it: Salla's bundle features sit in its products concern (SA-C-020) and are cited in the Salla cell.

Inventory: Shopify's Inventory section, route, entitlement and plan row (SH-S-1511, SH-S-5192, SH-S-7009). Its history and counts statements are cited in CM-INV-002 and CM-INV-003. Outside CM-INV-001's tree, its route products:update:locations (SH-S-5024), a product's stock at a location, is cited in CM-INV-005, which is why the fit is strained (S1).
Inventory, Product Quantity and inventory management (SA-S-1688, SA-S-1030, SA-S-1976). Its inventory log is cited in CM-INV-002 and its low-quantity alert in CM-INV-004.

A reading, joined on role with Salla's branches and warehouses (SA-C-026): both are the places where a store's stock is held. Shopify calls them 'Inventory locations' in its plan table (SH-S-7010) and keeps them in Settings > Locations (SH-S-1493); Salla names a branch or warehouse (فرع / مستودع) in its branch webhooks (SA-S-1616) and holds stock per branch (enable_branch_inventories, SA-S-3504; unlimited-quantity-by-branch, SA-S-3516). Rules U-003.

A reading, joined on role with Shopify's locations (SH-C-024), as that landing says. Outside CM-INV-005's tree, its inventory transfer link and permissions (SA-S-1798, SA-S-2303 to SA-S-2306, SA-S-2520) are cited in CM-INV-006, now a child of CM-INV-001 (S2), which is why the fit is strained (S1): only Q1's concern groups transfer with branches. Its 'Branch and warehouse priority order' setting (SA-S-1755) bears on order routing (SH-C-060, domain C; U-020) and is not cited here.

Transfers, shipments and purchase orders: coarser than either of CM-INV-006 and CM-INV-007, which are siblings under inventory by Shopify's own grouping (S2), so the concern lands in their parent, CM-INV-001, where Shopify's inventory entitlement holds transferLocation and purchaseOrders beside counts (SH-C-023/decides/SH-S-5334). Its transfers and shipments are cited in CM-INV-006, joined by the term inventory transfer with the transfer part of Salla's SA-C-026 (SA-S-1798, SA-S-2520); its purchase orders and suppliers are cited in CM-INV-007.
